The series is trend_dominated and the ranking is unstable, so I want to test if a more robust combination like DBA (Dynamic Barycentric Averaging) on the high-performing pool1 can outperform the simple mean of pool5.
Testing if a trimmed mean on the full pool can handle the unstable ranking by mitigating the influence of models with high variance errors.
Testing if softmax weighting on a specialized high-performing pool (pool1) can outperform the simple mean of pool5, given the unstable ranking.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool5' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9824. Series context: trend strength 0.9761 and seasonal strength 0.4355; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.092); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.242.
